result.reason: The clause adds 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day non-renewal deadline, and the required 60-day Vendor reminder, but it omits any cap on renewal price increases. It therefore reaches neither the preferred position (lesser of CPI and 3%) nor the fallback (no more than 5%). It also unnecessarily reduces the separate post-Initial Term convenience-termination period from 90 to 30 days, materially changing an unrelated termination right and the associated fee period. The overlapping convenience-termination and non-renewal provisions are professionally understandable but redundant.
